entries.title: Getting Started
entries.summary: Install the framework and point its entry points at your own content directory to start building.

entries.title: Welcome
entries.summary: This is the tiny fixture site the framework's own build/serve/test entry points use by default (M1 corrective deliverable 5). It carries no site-specific branding -- a real site supplies its own content directory and config instead.

entries.title: Alpha Guide
entries.summary: The first of two nested fixture pages, used to exercise auto-discovered nested routing and navigation ordering.

entries.title: Beta Guide
entries.summary: The second of two nested fixture pages, ordered after Alpha via order.
